verdict.rationale: Radar's own documented rules can request 3D Secure for selected payments, such as payments from new customers. That covers part of triggering 3DS when risky. Nothing in the evidence shows SCA-aware routing for European traffic, automatic 3DS when regulation requires it, or requesting SCA exemptions for low-risk payments. Missing for 10: SCA exemption requests, automatic regulatory 3DS triggering, EU-specific routing logic, conversion/compliance balancing evidence, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, European traffic is routed intelligently through SCA — 3DS triggered when required or risky, exemptions requested when safe — to protect both compliance and conversion

citations.quote: Request 3D Secure (3DS) for all payments that support it and are made by a new customer
you can also set up rules that are unique to your business using the supported attributes
